REST.notes: Canonical neutral matches the Iteration 1 reference.

READY.notes: Readable as a restrained game-ready stance.

STEP_LEFT.notes: Leg opposition is visible and the static step stays within the safe envelope.

STEP_RIGHT.notes: Mirrored leg opposition is visible and remains within the safe envelope.

LEAN_LEFT.notes: Directional body lean is visible without severe deformation.

LEAN_RIGHT.notes: Mirrored directional body lean is visible without severe deformation.

POINT_LEFT.notes: The arm reaches clearly toward the indicated side within the tested range.

POINT_RIGHT.notes: Mirrored arm reach is visible within the tested range.

TURN_LEFT.notes: Whole-rig turn is readable without destructive mesh twist.

TURN_RIGHT.notes: Mirrored whole-rig turn is readable without destructive mesh twist.

CROUCH.notes: Gameplay-camera view remains too close to standing to read as a clear compressed crouch.

JUMP_ANTICIPATION.notes: Gameplay-camera view does not clearly read as a pre-jump loading pose; it remains too close to standing.

JUMP_TAKEOFF.notes: Static extension pose is readable and stays within the conservative envelope.

JUMP_APEX.notes: Airborne silhouette is readable with the recorded COG vertical offset.

LANDING.notes: Shallow impact absorption is readable and remains within the safe knee cap.
